# Fact: Home Office Setup

## Statement

Alex has a standing desk with dual monitors in a dedicated home office space.

## Context

The standing desk allows alternating between sitting and standing throughout the workday.
The dual monitor setup consists of a 27-inch primary display and a 24-inch secondary display.
The home office also has good natural light from a north-facing window.
An ergonomic chair is used when sitting.
